{{Conjecture|legends}}
The [[Balinaka]] '''language''' was spoken by the natives of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garnib]].

==Known words==
*''[[Heswe]]'' - A city's agora.
*''[[Sewfes]]'' - A typical carved underground city.
*''[[Wallarand]]'' - A four-day summer festival.

==Known phrases==
*''Guyef-do? Guyef-tes, nosyarg, jefsewarg.'' - Hypothermia-me? Hypothermia-you, insult-me-not, dunk-water-not!
